inputs.description: The building's IFC file; any IFC model works here.
inputs.name: model

about.text: Colours each element by a group of IFC categories, so the palette's 10 colours stay distinct: walls, structure, slabs, roofs, doors, windows, stairs and railings, coverings, furniture, other. Spaces and openings are left out. groups lists each category with its instance count and group; on the Duplex 13 categories fold into 9 groups over 693 instances.

groups.name: group
groups.expr: category in ('IFCWALL', 'IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE', 'IFCCURTAINWALL') ? 'Walls' : (category in ('IFCBEAM', 'IFCCOLUMN', 'IFCMEMBER', 'IFCFOOTING', 'IFCPILE', 'IFCPLATE') ? 'Structure' : (category == 'IFCSLAB' ? 'Slabs' : (category == 'IFCROOF' ? 'Roofs' : (category == 'IFCDOOR' ? 'Doors' : (category == 'IFCWINDOW' ? 'Windows' : (category in ('IFCSTAIR', 'IFCSTAIRFLIGHT', 'IFCRAILING', 'IFCRAMP', 'IFCRAMPFLIGHT') ? 'Stairs and railings' : (category == 'IFCCOVERING' ? 'Coverings' : (category in ('IFCFURNISHINGELEMENT', 'IFCFURNITURE') ? 'Furniture' : 'Other'))))))))
